source: ML-080 familiar active/active CALIBRATION only; no protected cases
selection: first 48 second-event agent calibration prompts after SHA256 lexical sort
random_baseline: isotropic Gaussian normalized to recipient-donor site delta per question
lexical_control: one distractor verb substitution preserving correct answer; NOT norm matched to role or event
positive_control: last-layer final-token residual patch copies donor readout, so is NOT evidence for a unique circuit
primary_descriptive: mean gold-vs-best-other candidate margin reduction by patch and site
auxiliary: native candidate accuracy, donor-relative logit shifts, effect norms, matched random control
note: Exploratory discovery; same examples for all models; no independent or prospective mechanism validation
